title: RuneScape Dragonwilds: Kuldra Boss new bug (fixed)
author: Bazilleos
description: Happens every time you repeat final boss. Commander teleports you to the next platform and in doing so you spawn in middle of the ground and fall down to the death

comments.author: @Ruutger
comments.text:
Jagex:

Hello adventurers, we're applying a fix to resolve the outstanding issue with the Kuldra Boss encounter.

We will be rolling this patch out to console platforms as quickly as possible. We are not waiting for each respective console platform before shipping this patch.

This will mean platforms on mismatched patches will not be able to crossplay together.

We cannot guarantee a timeline for when each platform gets their respective patch due to console verification timelines, so we appreciate your patience.

Nintendo Switch 2 users will get the patch next week.

comments.author: @Oonarahk12
comments.text: The 1.0 multi-platform release has been so scuffed.  All these bugs seem blindingly obvious and it beggars the mind as to how QA failed to catch them.

comments.author: @kawikakuahine6297
comments.text: This has happened to me four times already!!!!!
